mechanism_narrative: A sustained 4-quarter decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 < 1.5% for 4 consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 2.0% signals accelerating manufacturing output, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 2.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise and corporate earnings growth slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 consecutive months.
